name: Memento Vivere
source:
All things that live upon the Earth must eventually die. So what happens when this immutable law of nature is turned inside-out?

Grey is an unremarkable man living in remarkable times. Ripped away from the comforts of modern civilization, with his city in ruins and everyone he cares about suddenly at risk, he will be forced to confront unimaginable horrors just to survive.

But the undead monsters roaming the city streets outside are not the only danger in Grey's new world. He will have to contend with his fellow survivors -- some of whom are not what they appear to be. And he will also have to come to terms with the monsters that lurk inside his own head.

Though trapped in a waking nightmare, he may still learn to hope for a better life. Throughout his journeys, he will have a chance to find love, to rekindle old bonds, and to forge new friendships. Yet to see the light at the end of the tunnel, he will first have to stumble through the darkness.

Ultimately, his fate rests in your hands.

Just surviving will not be enough.

Memento Vivere. Remember to live.
